layout.body: When many people think of coffee in Africa, they think mainly of growing and harvesting beans. lt's true that Ethiopia and Uganda are often ranked among the world's top ten coffee-producing nations.But in recent years, coffee shop culture has become popular in some urban areas in Africa. Big-name international coffee shops are certainly behind this,but local business people have also played a part.Patrick Edun, founder of the coffee shop chain Mambila Café, thought there would be interest in his native city Lagos for places to meet with friends and listen to music while enjoying coffee and snacks.Edun also committed to using only high-quality Nigerian or Ethiopian beans to make coffee drinks.He now operates five Mambila Café locations in Lagos. He faces competition there from three other locally owned coffee shop chains, each with its own unique spin on coffee shop culture.

questions.stem: Which headline best summarizes the article?

options.A: Best New Places to Dine in Lagos
options.B: Local Coffee Shop Culture on the Rise
options.C: International Coffee Chains Leave Urban Areas
options.D: Nigeria's Place in the Coffee Production Rankings

questions.analysis: Which headline best summarizes the article? 原文依据：But in recent years, coffee shop culture has become popular in some urban areas in Africa. 文章主要讲非洲本地咖啡店文化正在兴起。 A：拉各斯最佳用餐新地点 → 范围太宽 B：本地咖啡店文化正在兴起 → 正确 C：国际咖啡连锁店离开市区 → 错误 D：尼日利亚在咖啡生产排名中的位置 → 只是开头提到，不是主旨

questions.stem: What is indicated about Patrick Edun?

options.A: He expanded the business he operates in his hometown.
options.B: He once worked for an international coffee shop chain.
options.C: He has participated in cooking contests.
options.D: He started his business with a friend.

questions.analysis: What is indicated about Patrick Edun? 原文依据：his native city Lagos … He now operates five Mambila Café locations in Lagos. 他在家乡拉各斯经营并扩展了自己的咖啡店生意。 A：他在家乡扩展了自己经营的生意 → 正确 B：他曾为国际咖啡连锁店工作 → 未提及 C：他参加过烹饪比赛 → 未提及 D：他和朋友一起创业 → 未提及

questions.stem: What is true about Mambila Café?

options.A: It was recently acquired by another company!
options.B: It only uses beans from Uganda.

questions.analysis: What is true about Mambila Café? 原文依据：He faces competition there from three other locally owned coffee shop chains. 他在当地有其他本地竞争对手。 A：最近被另一家公司收购 → 错误 B：只用乌干达咖啡豆 → 错误，用尼日利亚和埃塞俄比亚豆 C：在拉各斯以外有分店 → 错误，只在拉各斯 D：它有本地竞争对手 → 正确
